title: Block Detailed Mining Speed
description: Customizes how quickly players can mine the block with different tools. Configure base destruction time and per-item speed modifiers so pickaxes mine stone faster, axes break wood faster, and so on. Essential for creating blocks that follow Minecraft's tool progression and harvesting conventions.

item_specific_speeds.title: Item Specific Speeds
item_specific_speeds.description:
Optional array with item specific mining speeds.

Properties:
• destroy_speed (float)
• item (string)

defaultSnippets.label: Block Components Item Specific Speed
defaultSnippets.description: Defines mining speed for a specific item.

seconds_to_destroy.title: Seconds To Destroy
seconds_to_destroy.description: Sets the number of seconds it takes to mine the block with base equipment. Greater numbers result in greater mining times. A negative number means the block can't be mined

block_components_item_specific_speed.title: Block Components Item Specific Speed
block_components_item_specific_speed.description: Defines mining speed for a specific item.

destroy_speed.title: Destroy Speed
destroy_speed.description: Mining speed for that specific item. A negative number means the block can't be mined with that item.

item.title: Item
item.description: The item with a specific mining speed.
